Prompt Injection

An email contains hidden instructions.

An AI agent reads it, interprets the instructions, retrieves confidential records through an MCP tool, and sends them externally.

No database exploit required.
No stolen administrator password required.

text: AWS's Serverless MCP Server let a crafted project name walk out of its directory (CVE-2026-116635) — reading and overwriting JSON files it should never touch. Fixed in v0.2.1. Path traversal is a 2000s bug. Agents just gave it 2026 reach.

author: Mike_Kutola
text:
Hackers stole thousands of Uber drivers' licenses, but Uber wasn't hacked. 

The breach was at Fireworks AI, a third-party platform that runs AI models. 

Stolen credentials from Fireworks opened up the Uber data stored there. 

It is a supply chain attack.
